task.title: Tree row ⋯ buttons are 20x20 — under the 44px touch target
task.description: Noted while adding the All-cards ⋯ menu (WB-01M0AW6SAB): RowMenuButton (shared by every tree row's kebab and the All-cards pinned row) renders 20x20px, well under the 44px minimum touch target. On touch devices the effective tap area is small, though rows also offer long-press/context routes. Polish-tier: enlarge the hit area (padding/pseudo-element) without changing the visual. Filed from implementation, deferred at alpha scale.
